### About this dataset:

This dataset has data on `r nrow(penguins)` penguins, with `r ` species across `r n_distinct(penguins$island)` islands.  The species included are `r unique(penguins$species)`.

The average weight across all penguins is `r round(mean(penguins$body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 0)` grams, with a maximum weight of `r round(max(penguins$body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 0)` grams, and a minimum weight of `r round(min(penguins$body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 0)` grams.
